glosses: I mean; actually (introduces the correction of a mistake in one’s own remark)
by the way (introduces a remark of lesser relevance)
furthermore; what's more (introduces a further remark)

examples.en: By the way, what time is it?
By the way, where are you from?

examples.text: Aliás, por que você está aqui?
Aliás, quantos de vocês usam um diário?
examples.en: By the way, how many of you keep a diary?
By the way, where are you from?
